hook: Your phone camera can read a Hindi sign out loud in English.
title: Your Phone Camera Translates Signs Live
description:
Open Google Lens, tap Translate, and point it at a sign in another language. The text is swapped into English right on your screen as you move. Try it on any Android or iPhone with Google Lens.

#Shorts #GoogleLens #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Tried it yet? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone camera can translate any sign live.
scenes.headline: LIVE TRANSLATION

scenes.narration: Open Google Lens and tap Translate.
scenes.headline: OPEN GOOGLE LENS

scenes.narration: Point it at a Hindi sign.
scenes.headline: POINT AT A SIGN

scenes.narration: The words swap into English on your screen.
scenes.headline: WORDS SWAP

scenes.narration: Move the camera and the text follows.
scenes.headline: IT FOLLOWS YOU

scenes.narration: It works on menus and signboards too.
scenes.headline: MENUS TOO

scenes.narration: No typing, no photo, just point.
scenes.headline: JUST POINT

scenes.narration: Your camera now reads signs for you. Next: France's strange map.
scenes.headline: TRY IT NOW
